name: Maenza (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Maenza (a black eagle beneath a tower on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Maenza, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Maenza arms — black eagle beneath a tower on blue, crowned, within branches
